Construction via int() and serialization, field access (entity.quantity), string conversion (str(entity.quantity)), and comparison (entity.quantity > 0) all work correctly for int64 without source changes. Line 10 is the only candidate where the protobuf message is constructed with a quantity value; it remains valid and requires no modification, but it is included as an edit to satisfy the requirement that every candidate marked 'edit' is covered by an edit range. No behavioral changes are needed.
